setup: Reuse installed Node, PostgreSQL, Playwright, c8, ESLint and fast-check in the bounded disposable Compose runner. No new dependencies or commits. Separate fenced app-only release; no production order mutation for this follow-up.
behaviors: Both link dialogs expose one editable base quantity per item, labelled with its order UOM. Pallet, layer, section and piece quantities are display only.
PO base allocation 1673.6 SQFT against 2301.2 SQFT preserves 16 customer pallets and 6 residual pallets. Count allocation 16 EACH consumes all 16 target pieces.
Partial PO links derive physical coverage separately from each order line, including differing manual packing counts; full coverage leaves no phantom yard cargo.

TO options, suggestions, persisted allocations and remaining capacity use exact base quantities, including fractional values below one pallet or layer. Physical display is derived without rounding the base quantity.
TO matching and capacity group by item plus order UOM, and reject incompatible UOMs before writing. Existing allocations reduce remaining source capacity.
Negative, non-finite, excessive and stale requests fail atomically; legacy converted-only requests remain supported.
Background notices and order updates preserve PO/TO popup DOM, draft, focus and scroll; explicit refresh remains available.
Sety original route identity, photos, completed travel and 22/16/6 quantities survive. Dao completed driver evidence is unchanged.

failureModel.quantity loss or duplicate cargo: integration conservation and randomized proportional coverage
failureModel.rounding base quantity: fractional TO and PO persistence assertions
failureModel.cross UOM capacity: mixed-unit TO negative and remaining capacity scenarios
failureModel.partial writes and stale UI: transaction rollback and signature rejection regressions
failureModel.driver evidence loss: previous verified repair and driver save/reload regressions
failureModel.deployment drift: live capture, exact file hashes, image-only configuration, rollback and health checks
